name: desktopmanager-windows-verification
description: Inspect Windows desktop apps and verify requested interactions with screenshots and control evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Windows apps and verify desktop interactions.
interface.longDescription: Inspect Windows windows and controls, capture screenshots, and verify authorized actions through a local MCP server. Runs in an interactive Windows session and starts read-only.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Windows app and capture its current state.
Verify this desktop workflow with screenshots and control evidence.
